objections.statement: A binding packet could become a bag of unrelated identifiers.
Deployment fields could imply protected-effect authority.

reconciliation: Require one claim-set ref and an explicit recomposition target so every field participates in a single evaluation.
Separate deployment observation and authorization refs and prohibit all actuation fields in the unit.
balanced_unit: OperationalEvaluationBinding with exact claim, identity, profile, evidence, evaluator, freshness and authority-reference slots; no protected action slot.
split_merge_test: Splitting semantic meaning from profile mechanics preserves independent owners; merging either with actuation fails the authority boundary.
recomposition_proof: One binding instantiates a claim-specific C-control subgraph; multiple bindings plus dependency and aggregate receipts reconstruct W-ORODI-001-R2 without redefining any control.
